messages:
Ravi: Tiny holiday pop-up tomorrow 5pm in the kitchen? cocoa, bad puns, and a 60-second ornament swap. low-pressure. :hot_cocoa:
Kara: I will be there. bringing my infamous peppermint marshmallows (they are aggressively festive). :candy:
Eli: Count me in. I have a 2-inch Santa mug that needs a good home. Also proposing a 1-minute 'silliest holiday hat' contest.
Marta: Love it. I'll bring paper hats and some spare tape. Also can we do a quick postcard scribble table for remote folks to drop a hello?
Ravi: calendar-bot can you add event and set a 10-min reminder?
calendar-bot: Event created: Lounge Cocoa & Tiny Swap  Tomorrow 5:00 PM  20 min  Attendees: Ravi, Kara, Eli, Marta
Kara: quick heads-up: nut-free option please. I'll label my tray.
Eli: meme suggestion: bring one holiday GIF and the funniest reaction wins a tiny tinsel crown.
Marta: I nominate 'stealth reindeer' for the GIF theme.
Ravi: Agenda: cocoa, marshmallows, hat contest, ornament swap, postcard jar, meme GIF duel. See you in the kitchen! :sparkles:
Kara: remote friends drop memes in the thread and we will cheer virtually. :wave:
Eli: Also bringing a sad little playlist that only contains versions of Jingle Bells. You're welcome.
